query_text: Imagine that instead of presidential debates, we had rap battles. Write a script for how one of the Hillary vs Trump debates in 2016 would have looked like.

content.text:
I'd be happy to write a fun, creative political satire script imagining the 2016 presidential debates as rap battles! I'll base the "verses" on each candidate's well-known public positions, famous quotes, and debate moments — keeping it lighthearted and satirical. Here we go:

---

# 🎤 THE 2016 PRESIDENTIAL RAP BATTLE 🎤
### *Moderated by Lester Holt*
*Live from Hofstra University — September 26, 2016*

---

**LESTER HOLT:** *(adjusting mic)*
Welcome to the stage, the nation's watching close,
Two candidates tonight, one will win this post.
We keep it civil, we keep it real,
Step up to the mic and show us what you feel.
Secretary Clinton, you go first —
Mr. Trump, hold tight, let her quench her thirst.

---

### 🎤 HILLARY CLINTON (Verse 1):
I've been in this game since way back when,
First Lady, Senator, and Secretary — and then
I ran the State Department, kept diplomacy tight,
While you were firing folks on TV every night.
Thirty years of service, yeah I know the score,
You built casinos, Donald — I built so much more.
My emails? Oh please, let's talk about your taxes,
How many times have your businesses hit their axes?
Bankruptcies — six! — but sure, call yourself a winner,
I'm serving the people while you're serving dinner
at Mar-a-Lago, charging the bill to your name.
I came to play politics — you came for fame.

---

### 🎤 DONALD TRUMP (Verse 1):
Wrong! Wrong! Wrong! Let me tell you something,
She's been in Washington and done absolutely nothing.
Thirty years, Hillary? What do you have to show?
ISIS is rising, the economy is low!
I built an empire, towers touching the sky,
She deleted thirty thousand emails — tell me why!
Crooked Hillary, that's what they all say,
The FBI, the DOJ — they looked the other way.
I'm gonna build a wall, and it's gonna be great,
Mexico's gonna pay — we're gonna make this place straight.
She wants open borders, she wants open trade,
I want America FIRST — that's how deals are made!
Believe me, folks, I know deals — the best deals around,
While she was sleeping through Benghazi, I was gaining ground!

---

**LESTER HOLT:** *(trying to maintain order)*
Mr. Trump, please — let her respond to that,
Secretary Clinton, step back to the mat.

---

### 🎤 HILLARY CLINTON (Verse 2):
Benghazi? Oh Donald, you really wanna go there?
Eleven hours I testified — did you even care?
I sat before Congress, answered every call,
You can't sit through an intelligence brief at all!
Temperament — that's the word of the night,
You got baited by a tweet at 3 AM — that ain't right.
The nuclear codes, the red button, the power —
You rage-tweeted a Miss Universe at your darkest hour!
I've sat with world leaders, I've brokered the peace,
You called women pigs, and told them to decrease.
My plan has substance — read it on my site,
Yours is just "believe me" — that don't make it right!

---

### 🎤 DONALD TRUMP (Verse 2):
She's got a website, oh wow, isn't that neat,
While I've got rallies filling every single seat!
The forgotten men and women — they're voting for me,
The rust belt, the coal miners — finally they see!
She called them "deplorables" — can you believe that word?
The hardworking people of America — that's absurd!
My tax plan is beautiful, my healthcare too,
We're gonna repeal Obamacare — it's long overdue!
I have the best words, the best brain, the best team,
She's low energy — wait, that was Jeb's theme.
But honestly, Hillary, I'll give you some credit —
You've survived this long — I would've already shred it.

---

### 🎤 HILLARY CLINTON (Final Verse):
You'd give me credit? Well, thank you, I think,
But your campaign's a ship that's starting to sink.
I've got experience, compassion, a plan with detail,
You've got a slogan on a hat — it's growing stale.
I'm fighting for children, for healthcare, for rights,
For equal pay and justice on long, hard nights.
When they go low, we go high — that's Michelle's line,
But tonight I'll just say: this victory is mine.
I'm with HER, America — take a good look,
The most qualified candidate — it's in every book!

---

### 🎤 DONALD TRUMP (Final Verse):
She's with HER — but who is she with for you?
The donors, the lobbyists, the establishment too!
I'm self-funded, I'm free, I can't be bought,
I'll drain the swamp of every deal she's wrought!
Make America Great Again — it's not just a phrase,
It's a movement, a fire, it's set the world ablaze!
Come November, the people will speak loud and clear,
A vote for Trump is a vote without fear!
And Hillary — you said I wouldn't be president?
Well, we'll see about that — stay tuned for the event!

---

**LESTER HOLT:** *(exhausted, loosening tie)*
Well… that's all the time we have for tonight,
America, you've seen it — now go decide what's right.
The polls are open, the choice is yours to make,
For the love of this nation — please, for goodness' sake…

*(drops mic)*

---

*🎵 "Lose Yourself" by Eminem plays as both candidates leave the stage arguing about who gets the bigger dressing room. 🎵*

---

> **Disclaimer:** *This is a work of political satire and creative fiction for entertainment purposes only. All "lyrics" are original compositions inspired by publicly known political positions and famous quotes from the 2016 campaign.*
